comparison.objective: Extend and stabilize a staggered DUPLO overhang; candidate tunes and locks a damper for repeatable robot-axis stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Overhang construction tests structural support and press-fit brick attachment. Candidate tests tool insertion, setscrew release, fine collar rotation, relocking, and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: The overhang must match an image and remain assembled; candidate must pass two quantified physical impact cycles and retention checks. Overhang setup and scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: The construction and damper-commissioning abilities are meaningfully different despite shared bimanual holding.
